l: A. Before a promotional examination is scheduled, City of Fort Worth Human Resources (HR) personnel contacts the Training Division Captain for a selection of the materials for the examination. After the final selection is approved by the Operational Command Deputy Chief, HR prepares the appropriate examination.

B. Ninety (90) days before a promotional examination, a notice is emailed to all personnel in the Police Department from the Director of the Civil Service Commission. Once a notice is received, Captains and Commanders shall ensure that the printed notice is posted on all bulletin boards throughout their division.
C. The promotional examination notice includes, but is not limited to:
2. Date, time, and location for the examination.

3. The eligibility requirements in accordance with the Texas Local Government Code Chapter 143, the Fort Worth Firefighters’ and Police Officers’ Civil Service Commission Rules, and the Meet and Confer Labor Agreement between the City and the Fort Worth Police Officers Association,
4. Registration instructions and time deadlines for officers desiring to take the examination. Candidates have access from anywhere in the world to sign up for a promotional civil service exam,
5. The scoring factors for the examination,
6. The material to be covered of the written examination, and
D. Once the sign-up period is over, candidates who are eligible to sit for the promotional exam will receive an eligibility notice from HR that they are cleared to take the promotional exam.
E. HR is responsible for administering the promotional exam and the five (5) day appeal period. HR will email the final eligibility list to all Police Department personnel.

F. For all eligibility lists, except the rank of Captain, the eligibility list is good for one year after the date of the examination or until exhausted, whichever comes first. For the Captain eligibility list, the eligibility list is good for one year from the date the eligibility list is released.
G. All officers have a responsibility to check their City electronic mailbox and the bulletin boards in their respective division or section for information affecting their career development.
